headline: Paredes' pinch single in the 13th walks off Marlins
recap: Pinch-hitter Jimmy Paredes lined a one-out single to right field in the bottom of the 13th inning, scoring Peter Bourjos from third and giving the Phillies a 4-3 win over the Miami Marlins. Bourjos had led off the inning with a single, Odubel Herrera followed with a single that sent him to third, and Freddy Galvis was intentionally walked to load the bases before Paredes delivered the winning hit.

Marlins starter Tom Koehler worked five innings, allowing two runs on five hits with seven strikeouts. Phillies starter Adam Morgan went 4 1/3 innings, allowing seven hits and one earned run with four strikeouts and two walks.

Ryan Howard's 22nd home run of the season opened a three-run sixth that also included an RBI double from Herrera and a run-scoring forceout by Aaron Altherr, putting the Phillies ahead 3-2. Derek Dietrich's fifth home run of the season tied it for Miami in the eighth, and the score held at 3-3 until Paredes' hit in the 13th. Frank Herrmann pitched two scoreless innings to earn the win; AJ Ramos took the loss for the Marlins.
